display_name: The Twenty Thousand Martyrs of Nicomedia

names.form: Cei 20.000 de Mucenici arși în Nicomidia
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 decembrie, «Sfinții 20.000 de Mucenici arși în Nicomidia».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Δισμύριοι (20.000) μάρτυρες που κάηκαν στη Νικομήδεια». The page's name for the company is the one word Δισμύριοι, the twice-ten-thousand, and the rest of its line is a gloss on it; the rank word Άγιοι is left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 decembrie — «Sfinții 20.000 de Mucenici arși în Nicomidia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Δισμύριοι (20.000) μάρτυρες που κάηκαν στη Νικομήδεια»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps on the Romanian calendar, and the entry is the same company: the Christians of Nicomedia burned in their church on the day of the Nativity under Diocletian and Maximian. **The two sources name a different bishop and the folder's life is therefore left as it stands.** doxologia.ro's life, which the folder follows, makes the bishop of Nicomedia Chiril; saint.gr makes him «Ο επίσκοπος Άνθιμος», who ordered the communion of the Mysteries to be given quickly and baptised the catechumens as the soldiers and the mob closed in — and the corpus holds `anthimus-of-nicomedia`, whom this folder already relates, on a Greek 3 September. Which bishop stood in the burning church is for the author to rule on. The page dates the setting «Τον 4ο αιώνα μ.Χ., επί Διοκλητιανού και Μαξιμιανού» and gives no year of its own for the burning, so no `dates` object is proposed and the folder's dateless state is unchanged. It prints an apolytikion which names the δισμύριοι Μάρτυρες and is taken. It names two places of relics, «Ογκώδες μίγμα Λειψάνων» at the monastery of Stavronikita and portions at Docheiariou, both on the Holy Mountain; neither is drafted as a location. It carries a refusal of its own, in a parenthesis: a synaxarial source keeps with these martyrs the memory of Demosthenes, Demokles and Demokritos, «Η ύπαρξη όμως των Αγίων αυτών είναι αμφίβολη, διότι τα ονόματά τους καθώς και βιογραφικά στοιχεία γι' αυτούς δεν αναφέρονται από καμία Αγιολογική πηγή. Ίσως είναι οι ίδιοι και συγχέονται με τους ομώνυμους τους Μάρτυρες της 10ης Απριλίου» — the existence of these saints is doubtful, no hagiological source gives their names or their lives, and perhaps they are the same as, and confused with, the martyrs of the same names on 10 April. No folder is made for the three. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the entry itself.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.01.2026 (28. децембар ст. ст.) — „Светих двадесет хиљада мученика никомидијских.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and it is ONE FOLDER AND NOT TWENTY THOUSAND: the heading gives the company a count and a city and enumerates nobody, and the body names not one member of it — the archdeacon who encouraged them is «архиђакон» and no more, with no name anywhere on the page — which is BRIEF.md §4’s ruling on a company a heading does not enumerate, and is exactly how the 12-21 reader handled `five-hundred-martyrs-of-nicomedia` and `hundred-and-thirty-women-martyrs`. Identified on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep the company and on the whole account: the church of Nicomedia surrounded by soldiers and fired at the feast of the Nativity under Maximian Hercules, and twenty thousand burnt inside it. `dates` WRITTEN WHERE THERE WAS NONE AT ALL, and it is the first date this folder has ever had: death 302, off the entry’s closing «Пострадаше и прославише се 302. године». Neither of the folder’s other two books gives a year. `types` untouched: «мученика» is the `martyr` the folder carries. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS, and goes into the life: that the faith was flowering in Nicomedia and increasing day by day and that the emperor, staying in the city, learned of the multitude of Christians and was embittered; that his envoy came INTO the church after midnight and gave them the choice of sacrificing to the idols or being burnt; that the archdeacon, «јуначки војник Христов», took fire with a divine zeal and heartened the people by reminding them of the three youths in the Babylonian furnace, and said „Погледајте, браћо, на жртвеник у олтару Господњем и разумите, да се на њему сада за нас жртвовао Господ и Бог наш истинити; па зар ми да не положимо за њега душе наше на месту овом светом!“; that THOSE AMONG THEM WHO WERE ONLY CATECHUMENS WERE BAPTISED AND CHRISMATED THERE AND THEN, the whole people being roused to die for Christ; that they burned singing the glory of God; that the church burned for five days afterwards, with a smoke rising from it of an intoxicating and wonderful fragrance and a strange gold-shining light standing over the place; and that the dead were men and women, girls and children. No `locations`: the folder has never had one and a burnt church is not a coordinate a reader draws. NO SERBIAN NAME FORM WAS WRITTEN. The heading gives the company a count, a rank and a city and no name — «двадесет хиљада мученика никомидијских» — and a form assembled out of «двадесет хиљада» would be a phrase of my making, which is the 12-21 reader’s refusal on the two other Nicomedian companies in the same words. The `related` rows the folder already carries stand untouched and nothing was added; the new paragraph deliberately names no saint, there being none to name. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Θείον στράτευμα, πόλις αγία, περιούσιος λαός Κυρίου, ανεδείχθητε δισμύριοι Μάρτυρες, τη γαρ αγάπη αυτού δροσιζόμενοι, δια πυρός τον αγώνα ηνύσατε. Αλλ' αιτήσασθε, ελέους σοφοί τον πρύτανιν, δωρήσασθαι ημίν το μέγα έλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος γ', Θείας πίστεως — the only hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Δισμύριοι (20.000) μάρτυρες που κάηκαν στη Νικομήδεια», and it names them.

english.text: A divine army, a holy city, a people the Lord has made his own — so you were shown to be, twenty thousand martyrs; for bedewed with his love you finished your contest through fire. Ask, then, wise ones, of the Lord of mercy, that he grant us his great mercy.

death.note: The folder’s first date of any kind; `dates` was null before this reading, neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr giving a year. The Охридски пролог for 28. децембар ст. ст. closes the entry «Пострадаше и прославише се 302. године». The reign it names, «опаког цара Максимијана Херкула», sits around that year and is not itself written as an interval. Read 8 October 2026.
